Build mode

A chat that builds your blog

Talk to Claude beside your site and watch the preview change as it works. It edits the real Markdown and config in your folder, the way you would.

  • “A minimal personal blog with a dark editorial theme” — scaffolds the whole site
  • “Make the accent a warm terracotta” — re-themes it
  • “Add an about page” · “Rewrite my last post” — just happens
Write mode

A Markdown file with Claude in it

A plain editor beside a live preview of the real page.

When a paragraph is not working, Ask Claude tightens it, fixes the grammar, or adds a conclusion.

No API key, no extra bill

Runs through Claude Code on your own machine, on the subscription you already have.

Hosting that costs nothing

One click to GitHub Pages. No server, no traffic bill, HTTPS and your own domain included.

Files you keep

A folder of Markdown in your own git repository, editable anywhere.
